methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Start an eval run on an agent, or on a plugin.

 The eval run lives in its subject's organization, which pays for every
 try. It returns at once, pending; get it again to follow its progress.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description:
Cancel a pending or running eval run.

 Tries in flight are stopped; the eval run ends partial, "cancelled",
 with the results of the tries that finished. Cancelling a finished
 eval run changes nothing.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Delete an eval run with its tries' conversations, runs and scores.

 A pending or running eval run is refused: cancel it first.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Get a single eval run by ID.

methods.name: ListByAgent
methods.description:
List an agent's eval runs, newest first.

 Each eval run comes with its scores, aggregates, per-target results
 and notes, but with every arm's `tries` list empty, so a list stays
 small however many tries its eval runs ran. Get an eval run by its id
 for its tries.

methods.name: ListByPlugin
methods.description:
List a plugin's eval runs, newest first: those about the plugin, on
 the built-in assistant.

 Each comes as listByAgent's entries do, with every arm's `tries` list
 empty.

enumTypes.name: EvalRunPhase
enumTypes.description: EvalRunPhase is where an eval run is.

values.name: eval_run_phase_pending
values.description: Created; the suite has not started.

values.name: eval_run_phase_running
values.description: Tries are running.

values.name: eval_run_phase_completed
values.description: Every planned try finished.

values.name: eval_run_phase_partial
values.description:
The eval run stopped before every try ran; partial_reason says why. The
 results cover the tries that ran.

values.name: eval_run_phase_failed
values.description: The eval run could not run at all; error says why.

values.name: eval_run_partial_reason_cancelled

enumTypes.name: Harness
enumTypes.description:
Harness identifies the harness, the agent loop that processes a session's
 turns. Each value has one label, the same on every surface: HARNESS_STIGMER
 is "Stigmer" and HARNESS_CLAUDE is "Claude Agent". Every string that names a
 harness (the CLI flag, the account default, the model registry, usage) uses
 the first word of its label, in lower case: "stigmer", "claude".

 Each harness corresponds to a different Temporal activity type registered
 by the runner daemon. The harness determines:
 - Which tools the agent has access to
 - How conversation state is managed (Stigmer checkpoints vs the harness's own)
 - Which LLM models are available
 - Billing tier and cost structure

 HARNESS_UNSPECIFIED defaults to HARNESS_STIGMER.

values.name: HARNESS_STIGMER
values.description:
Stigmer: Stigmer's own harness. Runs any catalog model, open source end
 to end.

 Stigmer-managed checkpoints, custom tools, sandbox isolation,
 pause/resume, and full HITL approval flow.

values.name: HARNESS_CLAUDE
values.description:
Claude Agent: Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK. Claude models on the
 organization's own Anthropic key.

 Approvals that stop at the exact call, conversation state mirrored to
 Stigmer, model calls on the organization's own Anthropic key. A runner
 that does not carry the Claude Agent SDK refuses its turns plainly.

enumTypes.name: EvalRunTryState
enumTypes.description: EvalRunTryState is where a try is.

values.name: eval_run_try_state_pending
values.description: Planned; not started.

values.name: eval_run_try_state_running
values.description: Its run is running or being graded.

values.name: eval_run_try_state_graded
values.description: Graded; score holds the result.

values.name: eval_run_try_state_not_graded
values.description: Finished without a score; not_graded_reason says why.

enumTypes.name: ApiResourceVisibility
enumTypes.description:
Visibility controls who can access an API resource.
 This is orthogonal to ownership - visibility is about access control,
 while ownership (org) determines who manages the resource.

 Key distinction:
 - Ownership: Which organization controls/manages the resource
 - Visibility: Who can access/use the resource

 All resources belong to an organization. Visibility determines which
 users, inside that organization or in its child organizations, can read
 the resource. No level reaches every
 account on the server.

 The visibility levels map to FGA tuples:
 - PRIVATE: no additional viewer tuples (owner-only access)
 - ORG: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer tuple (everyone in the
   org — the org role hierarchy flows downward, so owners, admins, members
   AND read-only viewers all satisfy the organization#viewer userset)
 - CHILD_ORGS: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer
   (everyone in every child organization of the owning organization)
 - PUBLIC: retired; see the value's own comment.

values.name: visibility_private
values.description:
Only the owner, explicitly granted principals, and — for blueprint kinds
 in the cloud edition — org admins can access.
 This is the default for personal and run-scoped resources.

 Org admins count as owners of blueprint kinds (agent, channel,
 skill, plugin), so a private blueprint stays
 manageable — and visible — to its org's admins. Personal kinds
 (sessions) stay creator-only.

values.name: visibility_public
values.description:
Retired. This level made a resource readable to every account on the
 server; it is refused at create and at updateVisibility for every kind,
 and every stored row that held it has been moved to visibility_org.
 Sharing across organizations happens through plugins (a copy is
 installed and owned) or, from a parent organization to its children,
 through visibility_child_orgs.

values.name: visibility_org
values.description:
Everyone in the owning organization can access (read) this resource —
 all org roles including read-only viewers (the role just-in-time provisioning
 grants by default). Running or otherwise spending against the resource
 still requires the org-level member-or-guest permissions
 (can_create_session / can_create_run_in); org visibility widens
 read, never spend.

 FGA tuple: resource#viewer@organization:<org>#viewer
 (The tuple once targeted organization#member, which
 excluded viewer-role users; the authorization model no longer admits
 that shape.)

values.name: visibility_child_orgs
values.description:
Everyone in every child organization of the owning organization can
 read and run this resource: the shared catalog an organization offers
 the organizations under it (spec.parent_org). Child organizations
 created later gain access automatically, and no other organization
 does. Instances, sessions, runs and vaults are never shared
 this way: each child runs the shared blueprint inside its own boundary.

 Only valid for blueprint kinds with supports_child_orgs: true, and only
 in an organization that is not itself a child.

 FGA tuple: resource#child_org_viewer@organization:<org>#child_org_viewer

An outside issuer whose tokens Stigmer accepts for its own users

values.name: organization
values.description:
The boundary that holds people, Agents, Sessions and secrets
 together; nothing outside it sees them.

 Its id is a minted org_<ulid> that never changes; every organization-scoped
 resource names it by that id (metadata.org). Its slug is unique across the
 server and may change through rename; requests may name the organization

values.name: platform
values.description: Singleton platform instance representing the Stigmer deployment.

values.name: agent

values.name: run

values.name: session

Customer-owned messaging-platform app (e.g. a Slack app) that
 channels can install through instead of the shared platform app.

values.name: routine
values.description:
A saved agent invocation, run on an optional schedule or fired by Run now
 or over the API, acting as its owner.

values.name: memory
values.description: Agent-proposed, user-confirmed fact the platform remembers about a person.

values.name: plugin
values.description:
An installed Agent Plugins package: one thing holding skills, agents,
 hooks and MCP servers, which agents and conversations list whole.

values.name: vault
values.description:
A person's or an organization's box of logins (matched by a tool's
 address) and secrets (matched by name) that runs use.

values.name: score
values.description:
One grade of a finished run: a person's thumbs or a free run-health
 check.

values.name: scoring_rule
values.description:
AI grading switched on for one agent: its sample rate, monthly spending
 limit and judge model.

values.name: eval_run
values.description:
One run of test cases on an agent, or on a plugin on the built-in
 assistant, optionally with and without a plugin.

values.name: eval
values.description:
A set of test cases for an agent: an evals/ folder in Claude Code's
 plugin-eval format, pushed whole.

values.name: environment
values.description:
A named sandbox setup: the packages installed in every sandbox a
 conversation using it runs in, and the hosts it may reach.

values.name: file
values.description:
A file uploaded once and named by its id: given to a conversation with
 a message, held in a conversation's resources, or kept by its uploader.

values.name: plan
values.description:
Catalog entry naming a bundle of entitlements and the terms that buy it.

 Platform-level: a plan belongs to no organization, so it carries no
 authorization scope and no owner. Immutable once created; a change of
 terms is a new Plan and the old one retires.

values.name: subscription
values.description:
An organization's binding to a Plan; at most one active per organization.

 System-created: the payment system drives its lifecycle, so it has no
 owner and grants no roles. Its reads and writes authorize on the
 organization through the billing permissions.

values.name: license
values.description:
A signed grant of entitlements to a self-hosting customer for a term.

 Platform-level: issued by the cloud's operators and verified offline by
 the Enterprise server, so the customer is a value inside the license
 (which may or may not name a cloud organization) and the kind has no
 authorization scope and no owner. Claims are immutable once signed; a
 renewal is a new License.

resourceDescription:
EvalRun is one run of test cases on an agent, optionally with and
 without a plugin.

 Test cases are written in a plugin's evals/ folder, in Claude Code's
 plugin-eval format: a request a user might type, plus checks such as
 "the reply mentions the renamed function", "the skill was used" or a
 rubric for an AI judge. An eval run runs each case several times on each
 model it names and records per case the score and whether every try
 passed. It is about an agent, or about a plugin:

   - on an agent, it runs the cases of the plugins the agent attaches, on
     the agent with its own instructions, stamped with the agent's
     version so two eval runs of two versions compare side by side. Name
     a compared plugin and each case also runs without it, attached or
     not: whether the agent does better with the plugin;
   - on a plugin, it runs the plugin's own cases on the built-in
     assistant with the plugin and without it, as Claude Code's
     `claude plugin eval` does.

 Every try is a conversation: in Stigmer Cloud the eval run's viewers
 open it, read-only; in open source the eval run's creator owns it, and
 the other viewers read its scores.

statusType.name: EvalRunStatus
statusType.description:
EvalRunStatus holds an eval run's progress and results: per plugin, per
 case, per target and per arm, the score, the difference the compared
 plugin makes, and every try with its run.

fields.name: Phase
fields.description: Where the eval run is.

fields.name: PartialReason
fields.description: Why a partial eval run stopped early; unspecified otherwise.

fields.name: Error
fields.description:
One sentence naming what failed when the phase is failed, as in "the
 plugins' evals could not be read"; empty otherwise.

fields.name: AgentVersionHash
fields.description:
The agent version every try ran, as a version hash; empty on an eval
 run of a plugin, whose tries run the built-in assistant.

fields.name: Plugins
fields.description:
Every plugin a try loads: the plugins the agent version attaches, in
 the agent's order, then the compared plugin when the agent does not
 attach it; on an eval run of a plugin, that plugin alone. Each holds
 the version every try runs and its cases' results.

fields.name: Aggregates
fields.description: The totals over every case that ran, a plugin's or an Eval's.

fields.name: CostUsd
fields.description:
Estimated model cost so far of every try and every AI-graded check,
 in US dollars.

fields.name: TriesTotal
fields.description: Tries the eval run plans in all, and tries finished.

fields.name: StartedAt
fields.description: When the eval run started running and when it finished.

fields.name: VaultAttachers
fields.description:
Who attached each of this eval run's vaults, by vault id: the account
 whose permission to use the vault each try checks, since a try has no
 person.

fields.name: Evals
Audit
fields.description: Standard audit information (created_at, updated_at, created_by, etc.)

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAudit
statusNestedTypes.description: ApiResourceAudit contains both spec-level and status-level audit details.

fields.name: SpecAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's specification (desired state).

fields.name: StatusAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's status (actual state).

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAuditActor
statusNestedTypes.description:
ApiResourceAuditActor represents the entity that performed an action.

 This is the platform's single actor vocabulary: every "who did this"
 reference (created_by / updated_by, version-history applied_by / pushed_by,
 approval resolved_by_actor) uses this message, so actor rendering is
 uniform across all surfaces.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the actor.

fields.name: Avatar
fields.description: URL to the actor's avatar image.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description:
Human-readable display name (e.g. "Ada Lovelace"). Empty when unknown;
 renderers fall back to email, then id.

fields.name: Email
fields.description:
Email address of the actor. Empty when unknown or not applicable
 (e.g. machine accounts).

fields.name: MintedBy
fields.description:
The service account whose key minted the user token the actor acted
 through. Empty for every other credential, and on an actor that records
 no act (an account's profile lookup).

fields.name: CreatedBy
fields.description: Actor who created this resource.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was created.

fields.name: UpdatedBy
fields.description: Actor who last updated this resource.

fields.name: UpdatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was last updated.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: Type of the last event (e.g., "created", "updated").

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunAbort
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunAbort says which mock stopped a try, and why.

fields.name: Server
fields.description: The mocked server's key in the plugin's MCP configuration.

fields.name: Tool
fields.description: The tool whose call was stopped.

fields.name: Reason
fields.description: Why, as in "input.priority must be one of low, medium, high".

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunAggregates
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunAggregates are the suite's totals, in Claude Code's names.

fields.name: OverallScore
fields.description: The mean with_plugin score over the cases that ran.

fields.name: CasesPassed
fields.description: Cases whose with_plugin score reached the threshold on every target.

fields.name: CasesTotal
fields.description: Cases that ran.

fields.name: MeanDelta
fields.description:
The mean difference the compared plugin made, over the cases with a
 comparison; unset when none had one.

fields.name: CasesNotRun
fields.description: Cases listed but not run.

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunArm
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunArm is one arm's tries and their summary.

fields.name: Score
fields.description: The mean score of the graded tries; unset when none was graded.

fields.name: PerfectRuns
fields.description: Graded tries in which every scored check passed.

fields.name: GradedTries
fields.description: Tries that produced a score.

fields.name: Tries
fields.description: Every try, in order.

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunCase
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunCase is one case of the suite and its results.

fields.name: CaseName
fields.description: The case's name, from its case.yaml or its directory.

fields.name: Path
fields.description:
The case's directory, relative to the plugin's root, as in
 "evals/review-fires", or to the Eval's, as in "review-fires".

fields.name: CaseTags
fields.description: The case's tags.

fields.name: NotRunReason
fields.description:
Why the case is not run, as in "not run: plugins" for a feature
 Stigmer does not run yet, or "not run: scaffold skipped"; empty when
 the case runs.

fields.name: Targets
fields.description: Results per target, in the eval run's target order.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description:
Notes about how the case was run, as in "max_turns 4 raised to the
 run's minimum of 10 tool rounds".

fields.name: MockedServers
fields.description:
The MCP servers the case answers with mocks, and those it leaves
 unstarted, as Claude Code's mocked: line: a plugin's servers for a
 plugin's case; the agent's and its plugins' servers for an Eval's.

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunCaseTarget
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunCaseTarget is one case's results on one target.

fields.name: Target
fields.description: The harness and model.

fields.name: NotRunReason
fields.description:
Why this case did not run on this target, as in "not run: model
 'sonnet' is not in Stigmer's catalog"; empty when it ran.

fields.name: WithPlugin
fields.description:
The tries with the compared plugin; when no plugin is compared, the
 only tries, run with what the agent attaches.

fields.name: WithoutPlugin
fields.description:
The tries without the compared plugin; unset when the eval run makes no
 comparison.

fields.name: Delta
fields.description:
The with_plugin score minus the without_plugin score; unset when
 either is missing.

fields.name: Passed
fields.description: Whether the with_plugin score reached the threshold.

fields.name: PassK
fields.description: Whether every with_plugin try scored 1 (pass^k, k being the tries).

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunEval
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunEval is one Eval whose cases an eval run runs, as it ran them.

fields.name: EvalId
fields.description: The Eval's ID and slug.

fields.name: EvalDigest
fields.description:
The Eval version (archive digest) every try runs: the one the case
 source named, or the current one when the eval run was created.

fields.name: NotRunReason
fields.description:
Why none of the Eval's cases run, as in "no eval cases at this
 version"; empty when its cases run.

fields.name: Cases
fields.description: The Eval's cases, in directory order, each with its results.

fields.name: Aggregates
fields.description: This Eval's totals.

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunMockedServer
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunMockedServer is one MCP server as a case's tries see it.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
The server's name in the run, as in "plugin_tracker_issues" or an
 agent's own "billing".

fields.name: Tools
fields.description: The tools its mocks answer.

fields.name: NotStartedReason
fields.description:
Why the server is not started, as in "not started: no mock", or why
 its mocks answer nothing, as in "no such server on the agent"; empty
 when its mocks answer.

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunPlugin
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunPlugin is one plugin a try loads, as the eval run ran it.

fields.name: PluginId
fields.description: The plugin's ID and slug.

fields.name: PluginDigest
fields.description:
The plugin version (archive digest) every try runs: the version the
 agent's reference names, or the one installed when the eval run was
 created.

fields.name: Attached
fields.description:
Whether the agent attaches the plugin; false for a compared plugin
 the agent does not attach, and on an eval run of a plugin.

fields.name: Compared
fields.description:
Whether this is the plugin each case runs with and without: the
 compared plugin, or the plugin of an eval run of a plugin.

fields.name: NotRunReason
fields.description:
Why none of this plugin's cases run, as in "no eval cases at this
 version" or "not selected"; empty when its cases run.

fields.name: Cases
fields.description: The plugin's cases, in directory order, each with its results.

fields.name: Aggregates
fields.description: This plugin's totals.

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunTarget
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunTarget is one harness and model a case runs on.

fields.name: Harness
fields.description: The harness. Unspecified is the Stigmer harness.

fields.name: ModelName
fields.description:
A model id from the model catalog for that harness, as in
 "claude-sonnet-4-6". Empty uses the harness's default model.

statusNestedTypes.name: EvalRunTry
statusNestedTypes.description: EvalRunTry is one try: one run in a fresh conversation.

fields.name: Index
fields.description: The try's number in its arm, from 1.

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description: The conversation and run of the try; empty until they exist.

fields.name: State
fields.description: Where the try is.

fields.name: Score
fields.description:
The try's score from 0 to 1 when graded: the weighted share of its
 scored checks that passed.

fields.name: NotGradedReason
fields.description:
Why the try produced no score, as in "platform busy"; empty when
 graded.

fields.name: Error
fields.description: The run's own failure, when it had one, as in "timed out after 300s".

fields.name: CostUsd
fields.description:
The try's estimated model cost, AI-graded checks included, in US
 dollars.

fields.name: DurationSeconds
fields.description: How long the try ran, in seconds.

fields.name: Aborted
fields.description:
Set when a mock stopped the try: its input guard was violated, its
 agent ended the run, or the agent mocks' call budget ran out. The try
 scores 0 and error stays empty, as Claude Code reports it.
